data.name: Rauf
data.gender_notes: Rauf is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Rauf is an Arabic name that signifies the mercy and compassion of Allah. It is a popular name in Islamic tradition, symbolizing the gentle and loving nature of God. The name Rauf carries the meaning “Mercy of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Rauf usually hope their child will grow to embody mercy of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In Islamic tradition, Rauf is considered a name that reflects the merciful aspect of Allah, as mentioned in the Quran (2:160).
data.etymology: Rauf belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mercy of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Rauf total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: رؤوف
in_arabic.meaning: اسم الله الحسنى، رحيم، لطيف، كريم
in_arabic.long_meaning: رؤوف من أسماء الله الحسنى، و يعني الرحيم الذي يرأف بعباده، و هو من صفات الله تعالى التي وردت في القرآن الكريم، مثل قوله تعالى: 'و كان بالمؤمنين رؤوفا رحيما' (الأحزاب: 47)، و يدل على صفة الرحمة و اللطف لله تعالى

in_urdu.name: رؤوف
in_urdu.meaning: رحیم، لطیف، کریم، اللہ کا نام
in_urdu.long_meaning: رؤوف اللہ کے خوبصورت ناموں میں سے ایک ہے، جو رحیم اور لطیف کے معنی میں ہے، یہ نام قرآن مجید میں ذکر کیا گیا ہے، جیسے کہ 'وکان بالمؤمنین رؤوفا رحيما' (الأحزاب: 47)، یہ رحمت اور نرم رویگی کی صفت کو ظاہر کرتا ہے

in_hindi.name: रौफ़
in_hindi.meaning: अल्लाह का नाम, رحيم, लतीफ, کریम
in_hindi.long_meaning: रौफ़ अल्लाह के सुंदर नामों में से एक है, जिसका अर्थ है رحيم और लतीफ, यह नाम कुरआन में भी आया है, जैसे कि 'وكان بالمؤمنين رؤوفا رحيما' (الأحزاب: 47), यह नाम رحमत और स kindness की विशेषता को दर्शाता है

in_pashto.name: رؤوف
in_pashto.meaning: الله تعالیٰ نوم، رحیم، لطیف، کریم
in_pashto.long_meaning: رؤوف د الله تعالیٰ ښکلي نومونو څخه يو دی، کوم چې رحیم او لطیف په معنی دی، دا نوم په قرآن کریم کې راغلی دی، لکه 'وكان بالمؤمنين رؤوفا رحيما' (الأحزاب: 47)، دا د رحمت او نرمۍ صفت څرګندوي

in_english.name: Rauf
in_english.meaning: One of Allah's beautiful names, meaning merciful and kind
in_english.long_meaning: Rauf is one of the beautiful names of Allah, derived from the Arabic root 'ر-ء-ف' which signifies mercy, kindness, and compassion. It is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Ahzab (33:47), 'And He is merciful to the believers.' (وكان بالمؤمنين رؤوفا رحيما). The name Rauf reflects the attribute of Allah's mercy and benevolence towards His servants, signifying a personality trait of being kind, gentle, and compassionate.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rauf is commonly used in Muslim communities around the world, reflecting its rich cultural heritage. It is especially popular in countries such as Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Turkey. In these societies, naming practices often reflect religious and moral values, and the name Rauf highlights the importance of compassion, mercy, and divine guidance.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Rauf holds deep spiritual significance in Islam. It reminds Muslims of Allah's infinite mercy and compassion towards them, encouraging them to strive for goodness and kindness in their daily lives. By naming a child Rauf, parents are hoping to instill these qualities in their child, fostering a sense of empathy, moral responsibility, and a strong spiritual connection with the belief system. This name is a constant reminder of the mercy and love of Allah and the importance of reflecting those qualities in one's character.
